[[File:Banshee icon.png|left]]
'''Banshees''' are [[Slayer monsters]] found in the [[Slayer Tower]] that require level 15 [[Slayer]] to kill. Additionally, banshees tend to frequently drop many different types of herbs. [[Mighty banshee]]s are a higher-levelled alternative if seeking greater experience for a [[slayer assignment]].

==Strategy==
Players should wear [[earmuffs]], [[masked earmuffs]], a [[Slayer helmet]], or a [[Mask of Mourning]]/[[Helm of Keening]] when fighting banshees.

Not wearing the required equipment results in the following effects:
* Inflicts damage to the player up to a maximum of 10% of their max [[life points]] in typeless damage.
* Lowers [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Magic]], [[Ranged]], and [[Necromancy]] by 20% of their current level. At level 4, it cannot be lowered any further.
* Lowers [[Defence]] and [[Agility]] by 10% of their current level. At level 9, it cannot be lowered any further.
* Multiplies current [[prayer points]] and [[summoning points]] by 0.9.

Agility being reduced can be annoying for players wishing to use the shortcuts in the [[Slayer Tower]].

Banshees use a magic attack which hits from a distance. The [[Protect from Magic]] will work against them, but most players are likely better off using armour with a high magic defence bonus, such as [[dragonhide armour]].

Banshees are considered undead, so a [[salve amulet]] or [[salve amulet (e)]] will work. An [[ectoplasmator]] will also provide the player with Prayer experience.

[[Morytania legs 4]] will provide a 10% boost to slayer experience if in the slayer tower and on task.  A contract with [[Markus]] will provide even more additional slayer experience if the task is completed in the Slayer Tower.

As banshees drop many types of herbs and seeds, players can make use of [[seedicide]] and [[herbicide]] to convert them to experience. A [[herb bag]], [[charming imp]] and [[gem bag]] can also be useful for collecting their drops.

==Champion's Challenge==
Banshees are one of the 'races' who have lesser champions in the [[Champion's Challenge]] [[Distraction and Diversion]]. To fight the [[Banshee Champion]], the player must kill banshees until one drops a [[Banshee Champion's scroll|Champion's scroll]], a very rare drop.

==Trivia==
* The name "banshee" comes from the Irish, meaning "Fairy Woman"; in Irish mythology a banshee is said to scream when a person they know dies.
